correctness.rationale: The normalized Bergman projection yields an exact bounded forward weighted shift. Its diagonal self-commutator is governed by a rational cubic with strictly positive denominator. The adjacent affine positivity boundaries have strictly increasing slopes and strictly increasing intersection abscissae; telescoping proves the exact infinite supremum, including the nonattained limiting line. Completing squares gives all disks; positive exact intersection discriminants establish every exposed arc. Real-parameter endpoints follow by polynomial coefficient signs. Python standard-library exact-fraction diagnostics (1688 checks) supplement, and do not replace, the infinite proof.

broader_coverage.reasoning: The broader sufficient theorem contains only a subset of the complex coefficient locus. The block-Jacobi classification for shift plus diagonal and the differing-angular-degree classifications do not logically imply the displayed rational infinite-switch law.
